name: Mosaic Brands Limited
summary: Mosaic Brands Limited engages in the retail of women's apparel and accessories in Australia and New Zealand. It operates through Fashion Retail, and Multi-Channel Retail segments. It sells its products under the Millers, Rockmans, Noni B, Rivers, Katies, Autograph, W. Lane, Crossroads, and Beme brand names. As of June 30, 2020, the company operated 1,333 stores. The company was formerly known as Noni B Limited and changed its name to Mosaic Brands Limited in November 2019. Mosaic Brands Limited was founded in 1977 and is based in Rosebery, Australia.
